why: Halves the oscillation, leaving one smooth hump: the gun eases back and returns, which reads as a nudge or as the tank being bumped rather than as a mechanism cycling. Two decaying bumps are what make it legible as the gun working, which is the whole basis on which a refusal is read as that same work delivering nothing.
